zh_CN: 三种烟火油桶都可像流体一样放到世界中；源方块会向下优先、再向水平方向扩散，并显示 8 级液面。
空桶可收回油源；Cookery 油壶也可直接从油源吸取对应油。
基岩版里的烟火油由脚本模拟，因此不保证具备原版水/熔岩的所有互动；对大缸或 Cookery 油壶使用油桶时，容器操作会优先。
菜籽油提供约 60 秒烟火气；秘制辣椒油约 10 分钟；高级辣椒油约 20 分钟。烟火气剩余时间会显示在食物描述上。
使用：以油桶向大缸或 Cookery 油壶转移；刷烤架用装油的油壶，不是旧版油刷。
取得：榨油器完成一批后，从接收菜籽油的大缸用桶取出。
zh_TW: 三種煙火油桶都可像流體一樣放到世界中；源方塊會向下優先、再向水平方向擴散，並顯示 8 級液面。
空桶可收回油源；Cookery 油壺也可直接從油源吸取對應油。
基岩版裡的煙火油由腳本模擬，因此不保證具備原版水／熔岩的所有互動；對大缸或 Cookery 油壺使用油桶時，容器操作會優先。
菜籽油提供約 60 秒煙火氣；秘製辣椒油約 10 分鐘；高級辣椒油約 20 分鐘。煙火氣剩餘時間會顯示在食物描述上。
使用：以油桶向大缸或 Cookery 油壺轉移；刷烤架用裝油的油壺，不是舊版油刷。
取得：榨油器完成一批後，從接收菜籽油的大缸用桶取出。
en_US: All three Grilling oil buckets can be placed into the world as fluids. A source flows downward first, then horizontally, using 8 visual levels.
An empty bucket can collect an oil source, and a Cookery Oil Pot can also take matching oil directly from a source.

On Bedrock these oils are script-simulated, so they do not promise every vanilla water/lava interaction. When an oil bucket is used on a Big Vat or Cookery Oil Pot, the container interaction takes priority.
Canola Oil gives about 60 seconds of Hot Food time, Secret Chili Oil about 10 minutes, and Premium Chili Oil about 20 minutes. Remaining heat is shown on the food lore.
Use: transfer oil with buckets, vats and the Cookery Oil Pot. Brush the grill with the filled Oil Pot, not a legacy oil brush.
Acquisition: collect it with a bucket from the vat receiving a completed oil-press batch.

zh_CN: “普通”烤串配方是：毒马铃薯 → 蜘蛛眼 → 河豚；它没有普通的生串→熟串转换。
直接吃“普通”烤串会触发致命挑战；没有无敌效果时会死亡。
如果先吃黄金烤串取得无敌，再挑战“普通”烤串，无敌会被消耗，并随机出现“最强之盾”或“最强之矛”结果；只有盾结果能挡下。
材料顺序：毒马铃薯 → 蜘蛛眼 → 河豚
副手拿木棍或未完成烤串，主手拿可穿串食材，使用即可逐份穿入。
没有烤熟的未完成串、固定生串和秘制生串都可潜行拆解，取回材料与木棍。
zh_TW: 「普通」烤串配方是：毒馬鈴薯 → 蜘蛛眼 → 河豚；它沒有普通的生串→熟串轉換。
直接吃「普通」烤串會觸發致命挑戰；沒有無敵效果時會死亡。
如果先吃黃金烤串取得無敵，再挑戰「普通」烤串，無敵會被消耗，並隨機出現「最強之盾」或「最強之矛」結果；只有盾結果能擋下。
材料順序：毒馬鈴薯 → 蜘蛛眼 → 河豚
副手拿木棍或未完成烤串，主手拿可穿串食材，使用即可逐份穿入。

en_US: The “Ordinary” Skewer recipe is Poisonous Potato → Spider Eye → Pufferfish. It has no normal raw-to-cooked conversion.
Eating it directly triggers a lethal challenge; without Invincible, you die.
If you first gain Invincible from a Golden Skewer, the challenge consumes Invincible and randomly resolves as Strongest Shield or Strongest Spear. Only the Shield outcome blocks the lethal result.
Ingredient order: Poisonous Potato → Spider Eye → Pufferfish
Hold a stick or unfinished skewer in the off hand and a skewerable ingredient in the main hand, then use it to add ingredients one at a time.
Uncooked unfinished, fixed-raw, and Secret skewers can be sneak-disassembled to recover their ingredients and stick.

en_US: Three skewerable ingredients that do not match a fixed recipe become a Secret Skewer, storing the actual ingredients and creator information.
Secret Skewer nutrition is calculated from the actual edible ingredients rather than a fixed table; duplicate ingredients reduce the final nutrition yield.
An uncooked Secret Skewer can be sneak-disassembled. Once cooked, it retains the ingredient information used for nutrition.

zh_CN: 花椒本身是完成特制调料所需的三种基础料之一。
同一瓶调料中的花椒达到 4 份或更多时，趁热食用会额外触发麻木，基础约 45 秒。
折耳根粉会把这 45 秒按 ×2 或 ×4 的同一规则延长。
取得：空手采收结果的花椒树叶，一次掉落 1–2 份。
zh_TW: 花椒本身是完成特製調料所需的三種基礎料之一。
同一瓶調料中的花椒達到 4 份或更多時，趁熱食用會額外觸發麻木，基礎約 45 秒。
折耳根粉會把這 45 秒按 ×2 或 ×4 的同一規則延長。
取得：空手採收結果的花椒樹葉，一次掉落 1–2 份。
en_US: Sichuan Pepper is one of the three base ingredients required to finish Special Seasoning.
At 4 or more Sichuan Pepper in the same bottle, eating the food hot also triggers Numb for a base duration of about 45 seconds.
Houttuynia Powder extends those 45 seconds using the same ×2 or ×4 rule.
Acquisition: empty-hand harvest a fruiting pepper leaf for 1–2 Sichuan Peppers.

zh_CN: 取得：主手持烤串，潜行对桌子或实心方块的顶面使用，可放成烤串盘；回收时保留盘内内容。
烤串盘最多保存 5 串；拿烤串对盘使用可放入，空手使用会取回最后放入的一串。
直接食用装有多串的盘子时，会优先吃掉盘中基础饱食值最高的一串。
有内容的盘子可以潜行放置；打掉或收回时会保留盘内烤串数据。

有內容的盤子可以潛行放置；打掉或收回時會保留盤內烤串資料。
en_US: Acquisition: sneak-use a main-hand skewer on the top of a table or solid block to place a skewer plate. Recovering the plate preserves its contents.
A Skewer Plate stores up to 5 skewers. Use a skewer on it to add one; use an empty hand to remove the most recently inserted skewer.
Eating from a plate with several skewers consumes the one with the highest base nutrition first.
A non-empty plate can be sneak-placed, and its stored skewer data is preserved when carried again.

zh_CN: 取得：主手持 Cookery 空白食谱、副手持完整生串并使用，会消耗一份空白食谱，得到已记录的串谱；生串不消耗。
主手拿空串谱、副手拿完整生串并使用，可记录固定串或完整秘制串；被记录的串不会消耗。
记录后的串谱配合副手木棍使用，会从背包逐项寻找材料；缺料时不会部分扣料。
有记录的串谱可贴在方块水平侧面；拿木棍对墙上的串谱使用也会按同一配方快速制作。

Use a recorded book with a stick in the off hand to pull each ingredient from inventory. Missing ingredients do not cause a partial craft.
A recorded book can be placed on a horizontal block face; use a stick on the wall recipe to quick-craft the same way.

zh_CN: 放置空调料瓶后，对最上层瓶子加入材料；每瓶最多记录 8 份材料，世界中最多可叠放 4 瓶。

Mixing: Redstone grants Speed, Gunpowder grants Strength, and Houttuynia Powder extends effects. Totem and Dragon Egg Powders add special effects; see their material entries for thresholds.

zh_CN: 最短流程：打火石点火 → 放入 1–3 根生串 → 用装油的 Cookery 油壶刷油。

第 4 次翻面后使用特制调料；刷油和撒料都会按架上烤串数量消耗。

en_US: Shortest flow: light with Flint and Steel → insert 1–3 raw skewers → brush with a filled Cookery Oil Pot.
Use an empty hand to flip. There is about a 1-second flip cooldown; flip 4 times total.
After the fourth flip, use Special Seasoning. Oil points and seasoning uses are consumed per skewer on the grill.
After seasoning, use an empty hand to extract; sneak with an empty hand to extract repeatedly. Grill stages cannot be skipped.
If a stage is not advanced for about 40 seconds, the skewers become overcooked; they can still be extracted as Dark Grilling.
Keep an overcooked batch heating for about 20 more seconds and it burns into charcoal.

If you need to stop, extinguish the grill with a shovel. Timers do not advance while it is unlit. Breaking mid-process: unoiled returns raw skewers; completed returns cooked; overcooked returns Dark Grilling; other oiled intermediate stages return Mysterious Skewers.

Special Seasoning effects only trigger while the food is still hot; Hot Food does not double those seasoning durations a second time. Cold food remains edible, but those seasoning effects do not activate.

Merged heat is a count-weighted average, so one fresh skewer cannot instantly refresh a whole old stack.
